title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines report state only: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. One trade, or even a short live record, says nothing about a strategy. The figures below are the running record as read at 2026-11-17T03:16:58.332Z.

## What is open

- A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.
- htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper.

The live record therefore contains one open NEAR position and no open positions in htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, or trend-daily-v006. The open NEAR position is reported as open; no exit is recorded in the facts available here.

## What has closed

- htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade.

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That is one closed trade with a recorded loss. The trend engines show negative average net results over their small closed-trade counts, while htf-rsi-v007 shows no numeric average because it is null. These counts are small, so they describe the record so far rather than a settled outcome.

## What the market filter is allowing

- trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off.
- trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off.
- Both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper in this snapshot.

The trend engines also report which symbols are closest to their 20-day breakout:

- TRXUSDT is 13.39% below its high in trend-daily-v005 and in trend-daily-v006.
- ATOMUSDT is 18.95% below its high in trend-daily-v005 and in trend-daily-v006.
- AAVEUSDT is 19.40% below its high in trend-daily-v005.
- JUPUSDT is 14.56% below its high in trend-daily-v006.

These percentages are distances below the relevant high. They show how far each named symbol is from its 20-day breakout in this snapshot. They are not forecasts, targets, or signals to act. TRXUSDT is the closest of the named symbols at 13.39% below its high.

## Why a losing start is not a surprise

- Live starts: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026.
- In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%.
- A losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

The live record began on 1 October 2026 for v005 and on 9 October 2026 for v006. The closed-trade counts are 4, 6, and 7. The first live signal, ATOM, closed at -17.9%. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%. A losing start is therefore the expected case rather than a surprise. The record is short, and one trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Record updates and cross-checks

- The record updates continuously.
- The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The state above is paper only, and the same numbers can be checked in the performance page, the signal log, and the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the counts, averages, and filter state can change as new closes are recorded.
